title: TopFruit - MegaCrisp
summary: TopFruit's page for the blueberry variety MegaCrisp, identifying IQ Berries of Australia as the breeder and TopFruit as the commercial manager of the variety in southern Africa. MegaCrisp belongs to a Mega family that also includes MegaEarly, MegaCrop, MegaGem, MegaGrand and MegaOne.
why_it_matters: Recorded to correct an attribution. The Mega family that appears on the South African export variety list is sometimes assumed to belong to a large grower-marketer; it belongs to a separate Australian breeder. It also adds a breeder that was not otherwise in scope.

reading.rationale: Corrects an attribution and adds a breeder.

testing.rationale: No performance data on the page.

monitoring.rationale: Worth a fuller profile in a later wave.
